abstract: The world is going through a global crisis due to the contemporary Covid-19 pandemic situations. The coronavirus disease has recently caused a pandemic, in over 200 countries. It caused in billions of humans and causes numerous deaths. As this virus had been widespread, it is necessary to take precautions, especially in public places where people are in majority. Since, people in public areas are huge, it is a difficult task to check everyone and monitor them manually and the demand for sanitation. Thus, a system is made into existence which detects the person's temperature and opens the door to enter in. Once, the person is entered, it closes the door automatically. A sanitation system is also attached, in order to sanitize the person's hand. If the body temperature is high or above the prescribed level, it doesn't open the door and alerts the person. A switch is also placed inside the room, to open the door, in case of emergency. The system displays the person's temperature and the GO IN/KEEP OUT! message. Thus, this project focuses on reducing the manual work in public places to check temperature of the person and, to sanitize the people. Thus, this model ensures that everyone is safe during these pandemic days.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Routing Approach for IoT Assisted Smart Devices in WSN
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: With the rapid growth of the technology, nowadays more IoT devices are enabled and more data is transferring from one device to another device. Due to huge data transmission from one node to another a traffic or collision may occur in IoT Assisted Smart devices in WSN. To avoid the issues an energy efficient routing protocol is used. In this regard, routing is a challenging task while transmitting the packets to some storage repositories. This paper presents the Energy Efficient Routing Approach (EERA) to identify the routing paths where less energy is consumed to enhances the network lifespan.

articleTitle: Regulation of Frequency in Multi-Source Two Area Power System with TCSC
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Nowadays most people are aware of environmental changes based on greenhouse gases and pollution, the electric vehicle is one of the solutions to reduce the CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> in the atmosphere. The electric vehicle needs the charging points/charging stations to charge the battery placed in it. The charging time of the battery depends on the vehicle size, battery capacity and if the vehicles are charged at the peak hours, it leads to impact the frequency collapse. To avoid such collapses the interconnected systems to exchange the power flows and sustain the system remains stable. But sudden and significant load addition it leads to create the frequency deviations in both systems which are the systems inter connected. The primary objective function is to minimization of deviation in frequency (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Delta \mathrm{f}$</tex>), In addition with frequency regulations under load added conditions the secondary objective of the paper is to minimize deviation in tie-power (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Delta \mathrm{P}$</tex>). The paper proposes the FACTS controller-based load frequency controller (LFC) scheme. Here in this paper multi-area system is created with the consideration of non-reheat, reheat, and hydro types of turbines taken into consideration.

articleTitle: Internet of Things based Detection and Analysis of Harmful Vehicular Emissions
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this paper, real time implementation of detection of harmful vehicular emissions is proposed along with its analysis. The major source for the increase of air pollution in urban areas, especially in developing countries like India, is due to the large number of transportation vehicles. Of all the major emission releases from these vehicles, which is of particular concern is Carbon Monoxide (CO). At very high levels, CO can cause dizziness, unconsciousness and even death. It is therefore very important to keep an eye on the CO levels emitted by the vehicles. The designed prototype measures CO and Smoke (Particulate Matter) emission levels through a real-time process using a semiconductor gas sensor, that is, MQ-7 gas sensor mounted on the vehicle exhaust pipe. The heart of the project is the ESP8266 microcontroller (Wi-Fi module), to which the MQ-7 gas sensor is connected. The data collected in practice is verified against standard limits and provides information to the vehicle user and relevant authorities such as Regional Transport Office (RTO), Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) via the Global System for Mobile Communication (GSM) technology and the ThingS peak IoT analytics cloud platform for further analysis.

articleTitle: Design of SA and GA Optimized PID Controllers for Controlling Blend Chest Level of Paper Mill
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The present research paper is based upon the blend chest process pertaining to the paper making mill. There is always a requirement of controlling the outputs of multiple units involved in paper making like blend chest, headbox, wire, press section, dryer, calender, and reel unit. The final output is good quality paper rolls. To achieve this control, automatic feedback controllers are employed in paper mills. In this work, 2 different optimization algorithm viz. Simulated Annealing (SA) and Genetic Algorithm (GA) have been utilized to develop the control system using the MATLAB for monitoring of the blend chest process. At the end, the performance comparison of the developed control systems is performed.

articleTitle: Convergence Analysis of BIM & Blockchain Technology in Construction Industry Informatization
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Informationization is an important trend in the development of the current construction industry. Ensuring the efficient combination of BIM technology and construction engineering will not only help improve the quality of engineering intelligent information management, but also have a significant impact on the acquisition of engineering construction benefits. On the basis of clarifying the concept of blockchain technology, analyze the characteristics of blockchain technology, and predict the possible application scenarios of blockchain technology in the construction industry, in order to provide a reference for the new development of the construction industry. The article explains BIM and block Based on the chain technology, analyze its specific application in the construction industry information management, and point out its practical application value.

articleTitle: Observations on the Theory of Digital Signatures and Cryptographic Hash Functions
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: As the demand for effective information protection grows, security has become the primary concern in protecting such data from attackers. Cryptography is one of the methods for safeguarding such information. It is a method of storing and distributing data in a specific format that can only be read and processed by the intended recipient. It offers a variety of security services like integrity, authentication, confidentiality and non-repudiation, Malicious. Confidentiality service is required for preventing disclosure of information to unauthorized parties. In this paper, there are no ideal hash functions that dwell in digital signature concepts is proved.

articleTitle: Developing a novel steganography concept of audio data into audio streams
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Steganography is the art of concealing a secret message in a non-secret object. Cyber criminals, on the other hand, employ steganography for more than just sending messages. Steganography is a data-hiding technique that secures data as it is sent from sender to recipient. The encoding technique of audio steganography is conducted out using a programme designed for embedding the audio info into a new audio type of streaming. It's all about secure and safe embedding data/info in a seemingly innocuous covered speech modules. Using the fundamentals of steganography, this system makes the files more secure. Secret communications are encoded in digital sound using a computer-based audio Steganography method. The hidden info is again put in back mode by changing the byte sequence of a audio file significantly. Texts in digital sounds are more difficult to embed in most circumstances than hidden messages in other media, such as digital photos. In order to successfully conceal covert conversations, a variety of ways for embedding information in digital audio have been created. Simple algos that hide informations in the form of signal to noise ratios to more complicated systems that use complex signal pattern recognition techniques are all examples of these strategies. The following sections delves deeper into these techniques.

articleTitle: An Efficient Water Strider Algorithm with Auto Encoder for Cervical Cancer Diagnosis using Pap Smear Images
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Cervical cancer is considered a major cause of death from cancer among women. The severity of cervical cancer can be avoided by the earlier identification of the diseases. Medical image processing and intelligent models acts a vital part in the investigation of cancerous cells. Due to the recent advancements of several technologies, computer aided diagnosis (CAD) models becomes inexpensive and consume less time. Owing to the tremendous success of deep learning (DL) models in several medical fields, this paper presents an efficient water strider algorithm with autoencoder for cervical cancer diagnosis (WSAAE-CCD) technique using pap smear images. The goal of the WS AAE-CCD technique is for detecting the existence of cervical cancer using pap smear images. The WSAAE-CCD technique contains adaptive filtering (AF) based pre-processing to eradicate the existence of noise present in it. Besides, kernelized fuzzy C-means (KFCM) based segmentation approach was derived for determining the affected cervical cells and Residual Network (ResNet5) model is applied as a feature extractor. Finally, AE based classification model is employed and the optimal parameter tuning of the AE model takes place using the WSA. For inspecting the improved cervical cancer classification performance of the WS AAE-CCD technique, a detailed experimental analysis is made and the outcomes pointed out the betterment of the WSAAE-CCD technique.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic Based Maximum Power Point Tracking Design
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Need of renewable sources is increasing multifold day by day. The most abundant renewable source that is available in the environment is solar energy. Solar energy has to be converted into electrical energy for daily use. This can be achieved by using photovoltaic (PV) system. But the efficiency of a PV system is very less since it is characterized by many parameters like irradiance, temperature, latitude, rainfall, humidity and mechanical load. Since the efficiency is low, it is necessary to operate on maximum power from the solar cells using maximum power point tracking (MPPT). There are numerous proposed ways for tracking the maximum power point, with the Perturb and Observe(P&O) method being the most extensively used and competitive with other MPPT methods. This paper explains about designing a standalone PV system in partial shading conditions and implementation of fuzzy logic based solar PV system. This study and observation are carried out in MATLAB Simulink model and the performance of the system is analyzed.

articleTitle: A comprehensive review of Lung nodule identification using an effective Computer-Aided Diagnosis (CAD) System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Lung cancer is a nothing but abnormal swelling of lung tissues and could be a life threatening one. As per statistics, it is responsible for more deaths than any other type of cancer. It is important to identify and treat this anomaly from the patient's perspective. For identifying the tumour cells from CT scans, numerous image-processing and soft-computing procedures are used. CT scan images are mostly used in the image processing since these are high quality and clear images with more ppi (pixel per inch). Using this method, small nodes of tissues (nodules) can be found. In primary finding of lung cancer, patient's probabilities of existence are increased. Hence, an effective CAD system for lung tumour detection has been projected. This system comprises three points: initial level processing, segmentation and classification of nodules. The study of lung disorders requires accurate segmentation of lung images which is very important in detecting lung cancer. Lung images contains noise and weak boundaries so, accurate detection of lung nodule is very difficult or challenging task. This paper covers the comprehensive review of methods used for lung nodule detection.

articleTitle: CNN Based Smart Bin for Waste Management
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Solid waste management becomes a big challenge in urban area. As a large amount of different waste material is generated, it needs different kinds of treatment. All this mixed waste cannot be processed at once in a proper manner. One of the important processes in waste management is separation of waste. So far, physical effort is required to separate waste, this may be very harmful for the person who is involved in the waste segregation process. In the proposed system, an efficient automated waste segregation model has been introduced at the origin itself. Thereby, the system will reduce human involvement in the waste segregation process. This will be implemented through the concepts of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), a Machine Learning algorithm. The goal of this proposed system is to capture images of a single waste material and effectively identify and segregate it like biodegradable and non-biodegradable waste. Using Raspberry Pi waste can be dumped into respective bins. By using this method an effective waste management system is achieved and the process can be speeded up.

articleTitle: Authentication System for Automobiles using Face Recognition Methodology
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: There is a threat of losing cars these days due to various theft activities. The cars are being exchanged by car drivers in many social networking pols like Uber, Ola, and so on. During the exchange of cars among the drivers, there is a possibility for a theft activity to take place. In order to prevent the activity, safety measures are to be taken. In this paper, the real time face authentication for rental cars has been developed. An efficient face detection and authentication system for improving the security in rental cars is proposed. This is done with the help of image processing by using Advanced Haar cascade and Adaboost algorithm. This system can be used in automobiles by the owners of the rental companies to secure their vehicles as well as the customers. This system works on the decision of the owners. The car get started only if the recognized driver drives the car, whereas for further permissible drivers, the owner's approval is needed. If any accident occurs, immediately the owner gets a message to his mail and also to his mobile number. Also, this message is passed to the emergency ambulance. The location of the cars are displayed by means of Android studio app, which makes the owner to track the location of the car easily. The whole system is controlled by advanced microprocessor.

articleTitle: Convolution Neural Network (CNN) Based Computerized Classification of Adulterated Fruits with SIFT and Bag of words (BOW)
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Most of the minerals and vitamins can be obtained by humans with the intake of fruits. Fruits are very rich in fibre and health-boosting oxidants can be provided by them. With a daily routine of eating fruits, a human can avoid the risk of diabetes, cancer, heart diseases. But these days fruits are being adultered for the [1] economic and technical benefits. Adulteration is a kind of illegal act of mixing some harmful chemicals into the fruits in order to increase profits. Eating adultered fruits can lead to chronic diseases diarrhoea, cancer, liver disorder, and heart diseases. Adulteration is a serious threat to the health of humans. Even though the adulteration of fruits is banned, many traders are applying adulteration in the thirst of more profits. It is very difficult to identify the fruits which undergone adulteration with naked eyes. Image processing techniques can be applied for detecting the adultered fruits. In this paper, A Convolution Neural Network (CNN) with K-means clustering and Bag of words based technique is proposed to detect the fruits which undergone adulteration. Accuracy of 0.94 is achieved with the proposed system.

articleTitle: Bio Inspired FFA Algorithm for Efficient Data Transfer in WSN
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) have emerged as a key technology with a wide range of possible applications. In routing methods that are specifically intended for wireless sensor network applications. An major routing challenge is determining how to raise the overall network's energy usage while avoiding the electricity that leads to hardware failures or dying; this state causes the network to run inefficiently and contributes to system mortality. In any system, improving routing performance is an essential. In this section, wireless communication that use an optimized bio-inspired algorithm called Firefly algorithm (FFA) to tackle routing challenges is investigated. FFA also stabilizes abided the level of energy focused by routing mechanism which is in multiple ways. Along with FFA, the concept of Q-Learning is used. Q-Learning is used to select the necessary FFA parameter for each agent. Finally, their performance was evaluated. Combining these two strategies increases accuracy and overcomes routing challenges in wireless communication, according to the experiments.

articleTitle: Brain Computer Interface using EEG Signal for Actuating a 3 DOF Robotic Arm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In our world, more than one Billion people are disabled. These disabled people are affected by various disorders. The neural muscular disorder causes loss of movement of more than one muscle in the body. The physically challenged people and the neural system affected people must depend on other persons for their regular activity. The challenges faced by them can be overcome by using their brain signals as a means to communicate with others.EEG is now commonly used in various fields. Brain-Computer Interface allows a person to communicate and control the external environment without using conventional neuromuscular pathways. Transfer of information between a computer and a brain is now possible using Neurosky Mindwave mobile headset. Various activities of the brain are translated into commands through BCI. The commands are sent to Arduino via Bluetooth and processed. This paper is based on actuating a Robotic arm using commands received from the Brain signals with the help of Neurosky Mindwave mobile headset.

articleTitle: Scheduled single axis solar tracker system for improvisation of energy efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The availability of electrical energy has become a global matter of concern for all the developing countries of the world. Since, the generation of electricity is mostly dependent on the supply of fossil fuels, that are gradually depleting, therefore efforts are put in order to find and develop techniques to extract energy from renewable resources. The advantages of using renewable resources are manifold, starting from the reduction of emission of greenhouse gases to the electric power generation. Among numerous sources of renewable energies, solar energy is being immensely used, as it is abundant, economical and sustainable substitute for non-renewable fossil fuels. The main task of solar energy generation is to improve the efficiency of Solar Photovoltaic (SPV) generation systems. But SPV systems suffer from the exact orientation angle in order to harness optimum power from the sun. In order to overcome this shortcoming, a scheduled single axis solar tracker has been designed, which is dependent on the polar coordinates of the sun at different locations and time intervals. It can be noted from the results that during the peak time of solar energy harnessing, the constant power gain curve is obtained, that signifies the significant increase in energy production. Therefore, it can be concluded that using scheduled single axis solar tracker, the promising uniform surge in energy generation is observed as there will be less fluctuations and losses during the solar energy capturing process.

articleTitle: EfficientNet with Optimal Wavelet Neural Network for DR Detection and Grading
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is an illness caused by diabetes, affecting irreversible injury to the retina blood vessels. Since the traditional diagnosis process is expensive and time consuming, automated DR detection models are necessary to identify the disease at the early stage. The recently developed deep learning (DL) models make it an effective approach for accomplishing interesting solutions for medical image analysis problems. This study introduces an EfficientNet with Chicken Swarm Optimization based Wavelet Neural Network (EN-CSOWNN) model for DR Detection and Grading. The goal of the EN-CSOWNN technique is to classify the different stages of DR using retinal fundus images. In addition, the EN-CSOWNN technique involves the design of U-Net based segmentation approach to determine the infected regions in the fundus image. Besides, EfficientNet model is used for deriving a set of feature vectors and WNN model is employed to allot distinct class labels. Finally, the CSO algorithm is utilized to properly adjust the initial parameters (connection weights, scaling factor, and translation factor) of the WNN model and thereby improves the classification performance significantly. In order to demonstrate the better performance of the EN-CSOWNN technique, a comprehensive set of simulations take place on benchmark MESSIDOR dataset and the results depict the enhanced classification outcome of the EN-CSOWNN technique with the maximum accuracy of 98.60%.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Available Transfer Capability With Integration of Unified Power Flow Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In recent years, Significant increase in the power demand, deregulation, lack of investments in up-gradation of T&D infrastructure, poor in centralized power generation etc. leads to inefficient and unreliable operation of the electric grids. The proper placement and selection of flexible AC transmission devices depending on the network parameters plays key role in addressing above mentioned problems. In this paper UPFC placement is carried out under contingency conditions, to demonstrate the effectiveness of UPFC. The proper rating and placement of UPFC enhances the 60-80% of transfer capability of the existing electric infrastructure. The proposed methodology is tested on IEEE twenty four reliability test system. The obtained result shows effectiveness of UPFC in ATC enhancement.

articleTitle: Fruit Recognition Approach by Incorporating MultilayerConvolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Food has a vital role to play in our routine life. Individuals practicing agriculture has been greatly reduced owing to the advancement in industrialization. Incorporating the deployment of recent technologies in agriculture is indispensable. Disparate raw fruits from leaves and other fruits are still an exigent venture. There are precise resemble amidst the divergent variation of fruits. Categorizing fruits based on disparities inclusive of texture, formation of fruits. The existing system used to disparate fruits faces complications in categorize the fruits using machine learning algorithms and Convolutional Neural Networks. The proposed work manipulates deep learning with CNN, max pooling layers and fully connected multi-layer neural network, activation factors, flattening are applied to overcome the problems of aspects detachment. To reveal the proposed work, distinctive fruits inclusive of Apple, Guava, orange, Lemon, Papaya, Gooseberry, Grapes, Tomato, fragrant citrus and Mango are taken into account. Execution the proposed work, assisting in gaining accuracy in classification of fruits.

articleTitle: A review of solar powered electric Bi-hybrid vehicle compared with IC Engine Vehicles using graph analytics with AI
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: As the prices of fuel is sky rocketing and the problems of the normal gasoline engines are causing to the environment, the automobile industry is slowly moving into the electrically powered vehicles instead of the traditional old fuel combustion engines. This report shows the difference between a traditional engine vehicle and an electric powered vehicle, furthermore discussing about the advantages and disadvantages of electrical vehicles. In addition, the solar charging concept has been added to electric vehicles bring about renewable energy sources of charging. This method is not only used to save the environment but also to reduce daily running usage cost by using this electrical vehicle as an alternative.

articleTitle: Virtual Lab Environment For Programming Using Mean Stack
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Programming laboratories are very important for students to learn and understand the concepts of programming. In the recent past, the world has become digital owing to the pandemic of Covid-19. This has forced students and teachers to take up online classes and online learning methods. To make this teaching-learning process effective, especially when it comes to programming, virtual lab environment for C programming serves the very purpose. The aim of virtual lab environment for C programming is to provide students and teachers an interface to access the features of physical laboratories virtually over the internet. There are many benefits of virtual programming labs which include monitoring an individual student or class performance quickly and easily in virtual classroom environment, help students to easily access the content of the laboratory like problem statements, concepts regarding a certain topic. This helps education institutions to simulate the physical laboratory.

articleTitle: Construction of an Intelligent System for Elderly's Health and Elderly Care from the Perspective of the Integration of Smart Sensors and Physical Medicine
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This article discusses the necessity of developing smart health care and the main characteristics of smart health care. Based on the integration of smart sensors, the integration of physical medicine and medicine, the development of a new type of smart health care model of “integration of physical and medical care” centered on the home and the community, and the health detection of the elderly to realize personal health management and provide corresponding medical services. Starting from the three elements of testing-management-medical care, multi-level smart elderly care solution, and perfects the “sports medicine” in Chinese urban communities. Integrating the three dimensions of the health promotion service talent system, the construction of the health promotion service system of “sports-medicine integration” in urban communities in China has increased by 6.7%, in the hope of benefiting the construction of “sports-medicine integration” in urban communities in China.

articleTitle: Stock Market Prediction using Sentiment Analysis and Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: A speculator is behind every dollar traded in the market, just as billions of dollars are exchanged daily. Market conduct determines the fate of entire organizations each day. Financial specialists have always strived to anticipate the Stock Market since it has existed. Financial markets are now beginning to use and test the sentiment analysis-based ML approach. It is a tempting guarantee of riches and influence for a financial specialist to have the capability to anticipate trend changes precisely. When they get out of hand, stock Market problems and their related difficulties have no trouble finding their way to the open creative mind. A vital purpose of this study is to identify the best model to predict currency trading estimation. With the growing interest in artificial intelligence, and during the selection of methodologies and elements to consider, it was found that standard algorithms like random forests and SVMs weren't fully exploited to address this challenge, which is why the researchers used sentiment analysis-based ML approach, the Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) and Support Vector Machines (SVMs), which can be used to forecast stocks. In the following discussion, a comparison of SVM ML approaches and traditional forecasting methods was conducted to estimate stocks' market value.

articleTitle: Implementation of Intelligent Residential Fire Extinguisher System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: A new generation Intelligent fire extinguishing systems have been proposed to rescue humans and important documents which would be flamed. The Automatic Fire Extinguisher system can be controlled by Smartphones through Internet of things. It is a hardware-based model, accustomed automatically to extinguish the fireplace. Instructions may be given to the robot concerning its movement, turning on its water pump. It starts to manoeuvre within the direction with reference to fire intensity once when it senses the heat. The motor speed is adjusted with regard to the temperature range to pump the water. So that this robot pumps the accurate amount of water which is required to extinguish the fireplace. Proteus is used for Simulation of Fire Extinguisher and Python is used for coding in the Proteus.

articleTitle: Smart Attendance System Using Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Logging Attendance has been done manually for a very long time. With the growing technology and speech recognition functionalities, this process can be made more accurate without any wrong or misleading information. It is crucial to have a well-sophisticated attendance tracking system in corporate offices and educational institutions. Also, accessibility of attendance and getting a detailed status has become an essential requirement for everyone in colleges, schools, and offices. Unfortunately, there is no efficient attendance system and in this proposed attendance system, the speech recognition module proposed by Google is used in Python to make it intelligent and automatic. Speech Recognition is an interdisciplinary subfield of computer science and computational linguistics that develops methodologies and technologies that enable the recognition and translation of spoken language into text by computers. The proposed system stores the attendance by taking the voice input using App developed with the help of Kivy and provides a user interface to know the detailed status of the employees/students. As there is no possibility of the error except for the google speech recognition API, so a fully working and equipped is 95% accurate according to the Mary Meeker's annual Internet Trends Report which is also the human threshold

articleTitle: A Novel Approach of Applying Rank Ordering Clustering Algorithm in Agricultural Data
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Today, INFORMATION IS WEALTH and all information on transactions, science, medicine, etc. is enormous in nature. The usage of this large statistics, can analyze and improvise the choice making system in the agriculture sector, to pick out the type of crop to be cultivated in a particular area used for agriculture. This paper helps the intended person to seek out the sort of crop in their region and therefore the parameters are used to maximize the crop production using Rank Ordering Algorithms and Island Number Algorithm. The algorithms works on agricultural data. It additionally helps farmers to hold track of the ancient crop yield record with the aid of forecasting a reduction in danger control.

articleTitle: Design of Daily Safety Management System for Metro Traffic Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Different from the existing project management system, the daily safety management system of rail transit projects has high public safety requirements, and has the characteristics of high cost, high risk, and technical complexity. Once a major safety accident occurs, the social impact will be large and the loss will be huge. Based on the data obtained in the safety inspection, advanced digital information methods to increase the safety management of subway construction are derived from the results of several safety inspections in various aspects in each cycle. This article discusses the design of a safety management system based on daily subway operations.

articleTitle: Technology-Assisted smart sports guiding framework implementations based on smart data acquisition hardware
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Technology-assisted novel smart sports guiding framework implementations based on the smart data acquisition hardware is studied in this paper. In terms of characteristics, evolution hardware is a hardware system with self-organization, self-adaptation, and self-repair characteristics. Although the form of definition is slightly different, the inner essence is the same, that is, the evolved hardware is autonomous hardware. This feature makes the hardware no longer just passively accept the role of the outside world, but can actively adjust its own structure. Adapt to the environment. Repair the damage caused to them by the environment. Corresponding to this, CPLD also has to complete two functions: the primary function is to receive and register the command control word of the data acquisition module from the host, and then these models are used to construct the efficient smart analysis model and the applications on the sports guiding is discussed. The performance is tested in final.

articleTitle: Digital tracking of Migrants' Children Health Status by using Face Recognition Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Channeling the potential of digital technologies is highly important to accomplish the idea that human societies should live and meet the needs without compromising the ability of next generations to satisfy their own. This work is to minimize the partiality in the health monitoring of migrant populations who migrate either because of shelter, occupation and other reasons. The migration may be among towns, states, rural to urban or metropolitan. Hence, it is needed to keep a track on their health record in order to make healthcare services reachable to certain population in the form of continuance care. Immunization of infants is a vital field where complete vaccination coverage is provided to communities who are generally forgotten. With the help of Arogya Tracker app, migrants can keep a record of their child's vaccination and other health related issues and get notified about immunization according to their zonal areas. The website will be accessed by the government health care staff members to maintain the records.

articleTitle: Automated Brain Tumor Diagnosis using Residual Network with Optimal Kernel Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Brain tumor (BT) diagnosis using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) images become essential in minimalizing high death rate. The recently developed deep learning (DL) models have gained significant population in several areas, particularly in medical image processing and bioinformatics. The DL models have enhanced the performance of detection, prediction, and diagnosis processes efficiently in distinct fields of healthcare. Owing to the benefits of DL models in healthcare, this article aims to design an automated BT identification and grading approach by the use of residual network with optimal kernel extreme learning machine (RN-OKELM). The proposed RN-OKELM technique primarily performs pre-processing in two ways namely image resizing and data augmentation. To identify the tumor areas in the brain image, morphological operations are utilized. Besides, residual network (Res2Net) model is applied as a feature extractor and OKELM model is employed as a classifier for BT classification. Furthermore, the penalty parameter <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$C$</tex> and gamma kernel μ of the KELM model can be effectively tuned using water strider algorithm (WSA). A widespread experimentations were performed using the benchmark dataset and the results are inspected under various measures. The detailed comparative analysis reported the superior classification results of the RN-OKELM technique over the recent approaches.

articleTitle: Fog based Edge Learning using IoT: Concepts, Challenges and Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In innovation world, fog and edge computing is extremely near the client which means making the processing capacities extremely nearer to the customer or user. The mushrooming of IoT devices and usage is increasing day by day. Huge amount of data will be generated by these connected devices. Thus, there is an indispensable need to process such heavy volume of data in a quick and efficient manner. In request to meet the above standards. In this paper the research challenges of fog and Edge computing, the role of fog computing in IoT, the working model and benefits of edge computing are given in a novel approach after a detailed review, study and scrutiny. This enables and paves way to the researcher for a smoother and sustainable research scope in the fog and edge computing environment.

articleTitle: CoviFight: A COVID-19 Resource Tracker Website with Location-wise Search using Web Scraping
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: With the COVID-19 pandemic establishing its reign world-wide in the last two years with over 260 million cases and more than 5 million deaths, there has been an incessant need to quell the increasing fear and anxiety which has taken root in the minds of people. One way to do this has been to create an awareness about the global pandemic and arm people with a way to track various indispensable resources during these tough times. This paper discusses, in detail, the implementation of this idea - a real-time, COVID-19 resource tracker website which scrapes data from the most favored social media, Twitter and collates them to display the relevant information about the resources related to COVID-19; and provides vital particulars and facts about donation sites (in real-time) and general guidance in symptoms, treatments and precautions - integrated into an all-in-one website equipped with auto-completion feature and a handy navigation to increase its user friendly nature.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fashion Design Platform of Clothing Colleges in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area based on JAVA and SQL
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Intelligent fashion design platform of clothing colleges in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area based on JAVA and SQL is implemented in this paper. The integration of popular elements themselves should be able to process the elements from changes in form and structure, changes in size, changes in the quantification, and changes in direction. Hence, for the better analysis of the different aspects, the data mining algorithms are adopted, and the SQL system is then integrated for the data storage and analysis. For the smart and intelligent concerns, the JAVA is integrated to implement the system. The proposed model and the platform are simulated using the interactive system. The performance is verified.

articleTitle: Design of Digital and Robust Control Systems for Sugar Refinery
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In an industrial sugar making process, the extracted raw juice out of the sugarcane is first clarified in the sugar refineries. and then its crystallization is carried out in vacuum pans. In the sugar refineries, the pH control is performed in three steps viz. liming, carbonation” and sulphitation. The pH control unit for the sugar mill is the area of research chosen to write this research paper. In this work, for a considered transfer function model of the pH control system, the controller is designed in MATLAB using two different approaches viz. the robust control based on the H infinity loop shaping technique and the digital control using MPC (model predictive control) technique. The set-point response of both control systems have been analyzed and compared.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Mobile Dashboard and Supporting Sensor Network for E-Rickshaw
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this paper, the design and development of a mobile application and supporting sensor network that can monitor and display parameters of an e-rickshaw is presented since monitoring of electrical and mechanical parameters of a vehicle are key elements in the direction of energy efficiency. The objective is to create a responsive user interface mobile dashboard with audio, visual and haptic feedback that does not increase cost of manufacturing. The system allows the user to connect their device to the vehicle via Bluetooth as an alternative to on-board dashboards and displays. It is also an attempt to provide an economical alternative to inbuilt dashboards and thereby reduce maintenance costs.

articleTitle: Secure Model for Smart Car Parking System using Web Application
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Automobile traffic flow and the time it takes to reach locations such as offices, educational institutions, and so on are major challenges in urban areas. For the driver's convenience, a system that can warn the driver of the availability of open spaces in the vicinity should be developed over the transmission. This would be used in place of the existing manual method, decreasing the demand for people. A unique method is introduced for effective route optimization to avoid traffic in this study, which can design and process routes for route optimization. One has to wait in lines in public parking lots, but this method will shorten the time it takes to discover open spaces and reduce time waste. A concept of a smart parking system is shown through web application.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Information Platform for Human Resource Allocation Based on Fuzzy Data Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This article first introduces the current research status of human resource management systems and decision support systems at home and abroad, as well as the development status of data decision analysis in existing human resource systems, and proposes the application of C4.5 decision tree algorithm to achieve human resource data mining enterprise human resources The decision analysis solution designed and implemented the enterprise human resource decision system based on data mining, which mainly includes modules such as business management, data maintenance, and decision analysis reports. The results show that the efficiency of the human resource system based on fuzzy data mining has increased by 7.2%.

articleTitle: Application of Cloud Computing Technology in the Design of Visual Database of Physical Guiding Information Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this paper, the data visualization technology is mainly based on jfreechart for detailed analysis and mining of the educational administration database, and display through jfreechart data visualization technology to improve the use of data visualization technology in the educational administration database. For the current physical education work in colleges and universities, for the integrated management of sports information resources, apply cloud computing technology, analyze the requirements for designing a sports information resource integration system under cloud computing technology, and be able to combine the overall structure design, functional design, and software code implementation of the system. In part, the design and implementation of a sports information resource integration system increased the integration efficiency by 7.3%.

articleTitle: Analysis and Prediction of the Influence of Moving Object Trajectory in Indoor Environment Based on Infrared Camera Tracking
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the trajectory simulation generation of indoor moving objects and the prediction of indoor moving object trajectory in the analysis of the influence of indoor moving object trajectory based on the external red camera. First of all, based on infrared imaging, this paper implements a moving object trajectory simulation tool that can simulate different indoor environment positioning deployment maps. Then, this paper analyzes the trajectory of a large number of indoor moving objects, proposes an indoor hotspot area query method based on moving objects, and uses the indoor moving object trajectory dataset generated by the tool to verify the method. The results show that the trajectory prediction accuracy reaches 97.2%

articleTitle: Entity Recognition in Clinical Text Using A Hybrid Model Based on LSTM and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Successful analysis of clinical text is a challenge with sparse data available on the internet due to various issues. This paper proposes a model for Clinical text analysis to correctly predict and annotate the various keywords or entities present in a medical text which is mostly unstructured. The proposed solution uses deep learning models and NLP techniques. In this model, The basic training of the neural network is done using Bi-directional LSTM and Conditional Random Fields. The model uses an NLP pipeline that has the following stages: document assembler, sentence detector along with tokenization functions, and clinical Named Entity Recognition and Named Entity Recognition converter. With this model, the accuracy obtained was close to 86% on test data, of which individually the Named Entity Recognition converter has an overall accuracy of 90 percent. Improved accuracy was obtained by setting certain hyper-parameters and changing the required deep learning models even with smaller size of data.

articleTitle: Design of Smart Risk Assessment System for Agricultural Products and Food Safety Inspection Based on Multivariate Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Design of smart risk assessment system for the agricultural products and the food safety inspection based on multivariate data analysis is studied in this paper. The designed quality traceability system also requires the collaboration and cooperation of various companies in the supply chain, and a unified database, including agricultural product identification system, code system and security status system, is required to record in detail the trajectory and status of agricultural products in the logistics chain. For the improvement, the multivariate data analysis is combined. Hadoop cannot be used on hardware with high price and high reliability. Even for groups with high probability of the problems, HDFS will continue to use when facing problems, and at the same time. Hence, the core model of HDFS is applied into the system. In the verification part, the analytic performance is simulated.

articleTitle: Energy Consumption Analysis of New Energy Vehicles Based on Computer Simulation and Intelligent Data Layering
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this paper, based on the high-frequency big data of new energy collected by the vehicle-mounted terminal, the data is intelligently layered, and the characteristic parameter set that can reflect the fine spatio-temporal changes of driving behavior is extracted. The characteristic parameter set is optimized by computer simulation method, and K-means is used. The algorithm realizes the automatic classification of driving behavior, and analyzes the energy consumption distribution of different levels of driving behavior. The analysis results show that driving behavior affects the level of energy consumption of new energy vehicles, of which the energy consumption corresponding to smooth driving is lower. The results show that the energy consumption of new energy vehicles is 12% lower than that of traditional vehicles.

articleTitle: Mechanism for Predicting Forest Land Cover from Remote Sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: As humans intrude on forest areas, deforestation occurs. The main effect of this must be resolved by detecting and evaluating certain methods to protect the area of the forest. For example, deforestation has become a significant contributor to biodi versity loss and environmental problems. A model which may provide interpretable forecasts of deforestation is a significant tool for preventing the loss of forest area such as unlawful logging and grazing or planting. Advances in the study of satellite data and artificial neural networks have resulted in several ways to develop such a model. This article discusses the most commonly used machine learning methods. The primeval aim of this research is to develop a framework for comparing several evaluation metrics in order to enhance the existing solution and provide interpretable temporal predictions. This means that the image processing technique have tremendous promise for predicting deforestation in forests. The findings of this research will help to improve forest observation and policy initiatives for rehabilitation. This research deals with the vandalur forest area and detects the prediction of how much deforestation has been happened from 2008 to 2021 using satellite images. By comparing various models, the efficacy amongst the most frequently used assessment measures is investigated. The research finding suggests that different model for forecasting degradation may be used, as well as the areas lost throughout the research period. According to the data, 50% of the land cover area was deteriorated between 2008 and 2021. By 2030, it is predicted that 75% of the land cover area would have been damaged by constructions, condominiums, and parks.

articleTitle: Intelligent System Based on the Development of the Garment Design CAD System Module
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Intelligent system based on the development of the garment design CAD system module is studied in the paper. In the creation of human beings, the designer's thinking attitude is always expressed in a basic visual form. People's thinking is multiplicity or scattering. In the design process, the reasonable integration of big data should be considered. Since the fabric is a core three-dimensional object, it is necessary to analyze the fabric structure and fully consider the three-dimensional characteristics of the fabric to establish the surface illumination model of the yarn and fabric. With these ideas, this paper proposes the novel system that will improve the traditional CAD platform and achieve the goal of intelligent designing. Through the experimental analysis, the performance is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Dynamic Clustering Collaborative Modeling of Visual Communication Design in the New Converged Media Era
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This article is a research on the design of visual communication in the media form supported by digital technology, network media as the main carrier, and closely related to people's work and life. A multi-layer network dynamic clustering recommendation algorithm is proposed. First, the user's attribute characteristics are used to construct a user network; and the item attribute characteristics are used to establish a project network. The attribute weight connection is used in the layer, and the new score connection that combines the time and the score information between the layers, In this way, a multi-layer network that integrates attributes, time, and ratings is established. It explains the new opportunities that the innovation of new media technology brings to the development of visual communication design, and discusses the information dissemination characteristics, visual language characteristics and characteristics of visual communication design in new media. Aesthetics is also in terms of characteristics.

articleTitle: Resource Distribution Optimization Problem of Emergency Supply Chain in Emergencies Based on City Network Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This article focuses on combining the characteristics of the urban network supply chain and emergency management, based on the urban network mining algorithm and the service supply chain parties to find out the rules for analysis, and based on the profit demand and the degree of collaborative effort and the synergy relationship between the parties in the urban network supply chain. It is concluded that the ultimate goal of its service operation collaboration is to respond quickly under reasonable integrated operating costs. Demanders in emergencies can meet the needs of emergency services to the greatest extent, so as to maximize the overall benefits of the urban network supply chain, which can reach up to 6.5%.

articleTitle: Design of Visual Platform for Complex Medical Information Retrieval Considering Complex Information Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Design of visual platform for complex medical information retrieval considering complex information structure is studied in the paper. Before the software performs all operations, there must be a data structure that stores and describes the information transferred between the modules. The data transferred between modules is mainly the function information in the database. The function information mentioned here includes the function name, the return value of the function, the exit and entry parameter information of the function, and the description of the function in the database. From an application perspective, the semantic retrieval converts user query requirements into semantic concepts through semantic understanding and calculations, thereby retrieving the information related to this concept and the users really want, with this integration, the complex information analysis model is then designed. Through the testing on the different data sets, the performance of the model is then verified.

articleTitle: CPW- Fed Low Profile Resistive Loaded Antenna Design
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: A CPW-fed low profile resistive loaded V- antenna for wireless communication is proposed. The base antenna with double leg configuration is designed for 5.2GHz and the frequency is shifted to different frequency ranges by varying the number of legs to four and six. For changing the radiation pattern from unidirectional to bidirectional minimum of six resistors are loaded on the top of the six legs. The antenna is designed for very small dimensions with 14mm width, 16mm length and substrate height of 0.032mm. The antenna is fed by the CPW feed method through two conducting strips. The minimum angle selected between the legs is 60° and the maximum angle between the legs is 100°. A maximum of 6.4dB gain is achieved at six legs with 1KΩ resistive load and maximum efficiency of 86% is achieved at six legs with 100KΩ resistive load.

articleTitle: A Multivariate Game Quantum Analysis Model of the Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Green Product Supply Chain Channels
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The article studies the impact of artificial intelligence and channel strategies on the supply chain of green products. The article not only considers a variety of factors within the green product supply chain channels, but also product demand information including environmental information. Moreover, the retailer's information collection cost and the manufacturer's unilateral transfer payment when purchasing information are considered, and the interactive decision-making issues between the retailer and the manufacturer's information sharing strategy are completely analyzed, and established a manufacturer. A two-channel green product supply chain game model with a retailer includes, comprehensive consideration of the impact of product competition, cost structure and government policies on the equilibrium decision-making.

articleTitle: Blockchain and Trusted Computing Technology in the Construction of Smart Agriculture System with Modelling
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Blockchain and trusted computing technology in the construction of smart agriculture system with modelling is studied in the paper. Intelligent agriculture is the highly comprehensive system engineering, and it is becoming a new trend of world agricultural development. It can be seen that intelligent agriculture is the best choice for low-consumption, high-efficiency, high-quality, environmental protection and intensification of agriculture. Unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing platform as a new information acquisition method has also begun to be applied to precision agriculture, hence, this paper adopts the latest technologies to design the novel model with the robust framework. The blockchain and the trusted computing models are combined to serve for the data collection and processing units, the smart system is implemented with the IoT. Through the testing under different models, the designed framework is proven to be efficient.

articleTitle: Early Late Fusion of features for Skeleton based Human Action Recognition using Adaptive Kernel Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The identification of human action or behavior is very much discussed through the use of computer vision and artificial intelligence. Various action recognition strategies were proposed by many researchers to extract the action features in order to identify the action accurately. In the present article, we developed a new geometric feature fusion framework like score and features fusion on 3D skeletal data. First, geometric features like relative distance features, relative angle features are extracted from skeleton data. Next, various fusion models were adopted in early fusion combining features and late fusion after classifier to combine the output scores of both geometric features. In this work, the extracted features trained with the adaptive kernel learning classifier for recognizing actions. To test the working of our architecture, tested with other architectures on our own PACE3DAction and benchmark skeleton action datasets like PKU-MMD and NTU RGB-D.

articleTitle: Hybrid Salp Swarm Fire Fly and Hybrid Red Deer Salp Swarm based Routing Protocol in Wireless Multimedia Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In past few years, wireless multimedia sensor network (WMSN) experiences a persisting mark on the lives of everyone by facilitating in diverse domains namely agriculture, manufacturing, medical, educational as well as military applications. Currently, an intensive study and substantial progress were performed to solve various challenges and to provide optimal routing in WMSN. In this paper, a comparative review between two routing methods namely Hybrid Salp Swarm Firefly (HSSFF) and Hybrid Red Deer Salp Swarm (HRDSS) are presented. The significant objective is to provide an optimal routing path. In this paper, the details are enumerated on determining the objective functions namely delay, memory, transmission cost as well as packet loss. In addition to this, a comprehensive review particularly focusing on evaluating various performance metrics are analyzed and presented. Finally, the comparative analysis and the possible future research directions are also presented.

articleTitle: Smart Sociolinguistic Intelligent Analysis Framework Based on Feature Extraction and Matching of Structural Data
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Smart sociolinguistic intelligent analysis framework based on feature extraction and the matching of structural data is designed in this paper. Since data mining has added annotations to the features of the search data, when searching and searching data, it is faster and more accurate than traditional statistical analysis methods. This paper uses the SUSAN features, the method is simple, the anti-noise ability is strong, and the processing speed is fast. The matching similarity measurement should also consider the feature point direction information to integrate the structure features. For target matching, the side direction information can be directly represented by the feature vector formed by the two-directional cross template response, and the framework is then completed. The model is validated through the public data and the collected data from the Internet.

articleTitle: The Development and Application of Internet Medical Technology from the Perspective of Ethics
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This article discusses the connotation of medical ethics, the necessity of medical ethics education in clinical teaching, and its application in clinical teaching. Combining some cases of internal medicine, the application of medical ethics in clinical teaching practice of internal medicine is discussed from three aspects: the principle of medical ethics respect, the principle of informed consent, and the treatment of doctor-patient relationship. In view of the current status of Internet medical information quality, the necessity of carrying out evaluation work is proposed; the evaluation methods and evaluation standards of online information resources are summarized in detail, and some suggestions are put forward for the problems existing in the evaluation of Internet medical information resources in my country.

articleTitle: Evaluating system cost and complexity of finding Nash equilibrium for non-misbehaving nodes in CSRA game
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: As the dynamic communication network's infrastructure is decentralised, certain nodes may act selfishly. It compromises the communication network's security and causes path delays, congestion, and inefficient resource utilisation, among other things. As a result, a Nash equilibrium-based game theory with the parameter Price of Anarchy was proposed to find selfish nodes (PoA). Non-cooperative or selfish nodes are identified using the parameter Price of Anarchy (PoA). Resources are allocated to the active or normal nodes after the selfish nodes have been detected (non-misbehaving nodes). The suggested resource allocation outperforms the prior work in terms of throughput, delay, and delivery ratio, according to the findings, which were implemented in Python and tested in the SolarWinds simulation environment.

articleTitle: Closed Loop Investigation on Non- Ioslated Transformerless Converter for Photovoltaic Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The renewable energy sources plays a major role in electric vehicle and village electrification. This paper introduces a Non-Isolated Two Phase Interleaved boost converter (NI-TPIBC) with Voltage Multiplier Cell (VMC) which acts as an intermediate and promising candidate that connects PV source to the DC load or DC bus. Since PV is intermittent in nature and produces low voltage, the proposed converter is designed to achieve high voltage gain with moderate duty cycle. In this paper, the closed loop investigation of the NI-TPIBC is done to clarify its dynamic presentation. Under varying loads and sources, the controllers PID and Fuzzy Logic are used to test the NI-TPIBC. The transient response of the NI-TPIBC is analysed. The proposed converter has the ability to deliver constant power during the input voltage variation and deliver increased/decreased power during decreased/increased load variation condition. The simulation through Matlab/Simulink shows that the output voltage is well tracked by using the controller under external disturbances.

articleTitle: The Construction of the Integration Platform of Red Tourism Remote Sensing and College Students' Ideological and Political Education under the Mobile Site Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Based on the mobile site environment, this paper studies the construction of the integration platform of red tourism remote sensing and ideological and political education for college students. Firstly, it analyzes the overview of red tourism resources and the current development status. The significance and role of tourism resources in ideological and political education. At the same time, it combines the educational function of red tourism resources with the ideological and political education of college students, and elaborates its practical significance and necessity. Strengthen the ideological and political education of red tourism resources in several aspects, such as educational methods and educational environment.

articleTitle: ML Algorithm-Based Detection of Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In day-to-day life, while the plant is important for every human being to get rich vitamins of vegetables, the plant disease rate is increasing proportionally. The disease on the plant causes severe suffering to farmers economically. So, the plant disease is either to be controlled or predicted before it leads to big damages. To solve this issue, machine learning algorithms have been proposed to analyze the root causes of the disease and to prescribe suitable pesticides to cure the plant. Though many methods have been encountered to detect the disease of a crop, the existing methods failed to give accurate results. While many existing methods failed to apply image processing techniques and databases to store the crop data, the proposed CNN algorithm adopted these features by creating web applications to know the different types of disease that have occurred on the plant. The result witnesses that the proposed algorithms have shown improved accuracy (93.3%) which helps the farmer to raise the productivity of a crop. The developed app also helps young farmers to read and select suitable image options to improve the good yielding of their agriculture.

articleTitle: A Proposal for Low Power Test Pattern Generator
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: VLSI circuits entitle various challenges in terms of latency, area overhead, and power. Testing a complex circuit of VLSI design, Low power test pattern generation is a critical technique to implement. To minimize the concerned power, a method is proposed at testing mode itself in the very beginning of the circuit working also known as Built-in-self-test (BIST). The paper discusses a Low power test pattern generator (TPG) that works on modified clocks. Polynomials ranging from degree 2 to 11 are implemented for the proposed design using Vivado Tool and the parameters for each polynomial are analyzed from the results obtained. A detailed comparison of the analysis done for the Conventional LFSR and Conventional LFSR with Modified Clock was done.

articleTitle: Computer-aided Research on Buddhist Philosophy Estimation Based on Subconscious Data Collection and Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Computer-aided research on buddhist philosophy estimation based on subconscious data collection and mining is studied in this paper. The middle data acquisition part is the key to high-precision measurement of the whole system. This data acquisition system is based on AD-AI-VR core, supplemented by signal conditioning and filtering circuits, and CPLD and DSP are used for logical control and data transmission of the acquisition chip. Defense represents a protective barrier that then prevents subconscious content from entering the consciousness. These measures are subconscious in themselves. Considering these technologies, the designed model is validated considering the brain information interactive model. Through the systematic verification, the comprehensive results are tested.

articleTitle: Application of Augmented Reality Technology in Smart Cartoon Character Design and Visual Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper designs and implements a cartoon character design and visual modeling system based on an augmented reality platform, allowing children to create a three-dimensional cartoon scene from their two-dimensional hand drawings and perform interactive operations in the augmented reality environment. In order to enhance the realistic visual experience in the virtual scene, modeling and behavior control of the characters in the 3D virtual animation design are carried out. Create a three-dimensional virtual animation character model in the POSER software, create a three-dimensional virtual animation character skeleton in the 3D software and skin the bones to realize the animation character modeling. The skeletal animation technology is used to simulate the movement behavior of the character, adjust the movement and drive the bones in the 3D software.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Online System for Party Building Work of College Students in the Era of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Artificial intelligence helps to improve the timeliness, interactivity and accuracy of the party building work of college students. Through the design of fragmented thinking, the three-dimensional structure combination of offline physical platforms and online multiple virtual platforms is explored to explore the integration of virtual and real platforms for student party building It is a new way to more effectively realize basic party building work such as party member development, education, management, and service. Therefore, in order to integrate artificial intelligence into the party building work of college students, it is necessary to innovate the four aspects of thinking, management, operation, and cooperation, so as to promote the deep integration of artificial intelligence and college student party building work, and increase the construction efficiency by 6.98%.

articleTitle: Social Network Analysis Based Criminal Community Identification Model with Community Structures and Node Attributes
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Due to the rise of online social networks, community identification in complex networks has received a lot of attention in the last decade. Because it may be employed to identify important people and linkages, social network analysis is one technique to analyse criminal networks. Given the enormous diversity of actors (people) and groups involved in criminal activities, it may be necessary to investigate and assess their features in order to extract essential information and improve our understanding of their behaviours. The current work will use a social network analysis based novel approach ANOS OCL (analysis of sentiment on clustered leaders) to attain this important goal. Our approach claims to be computationally efficient as only the key actors (aka leaders) of the established subnetworks (communities) are taken into interest for further investigation rather than inquiring each and every person of a subnetwork. This distinguishes our method from other community identifying algorithms where complexity increases with larger networks. The proposed method generates small subnetworks that can be used to identify the list of people and relationships that should be inquired further. On the contrary recognizing subnetworks of interest utilizing other existing community identification methods produces larger and much complicated networks. This study explores users of a social media platform such as facebook whose activities supports criminal propaganda dissemination in varying stages. The interaction among such users provides sole insight into their behaviours.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modeling of TV News Convergence and Dissemination under the Visual Threshold of the Internet
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: TV news fusion has become an important form of influencing corporate marketing and consumer purchasing decisions. Unlike most studies that emphasize the positive role of opinion leaders in the fusion of TV news, opinion leaders can be regarded as both This kind of resources and power, but also with obstacles. The method of system dynamics is used to illustrate the causality of TV news fusion and dissemination from the perspective of opinion leaders, a system dynamics model is constructed, and system simulations are carried out to verify the sensitivity of opinion leaders to the effects of TV news fusion dissemination. The results show that the system dynamics model can better simulate the fusion and dissemination process of TV news from the perspective of opinion leaders in practice, which increase the efficiency by 7.8%

articleTitle: Real Time Electric Hazard Detection System Using Thermal Imaging
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper represents a low-cost thermal imaging and real-time system for electrical fault detection application. Available systems are mostly meant for industrial applications and are very expensive in nature. In this paper the proposed system consists of a Thermal Camera, Microcontroller and Buzzer which produces colour image and numerical values of the temperature and produces alerts when needed. Its proposed system scans the entire location of the surveillance. If the electrical system is failing or has other defects, the temperature at that particular area will be‘max’ or‘min,’ which indicates the condition of the temperature. A matrix represents the view acquired by the thermal camera. Each matrix member represents a temperature value. The Microcontroller divides temperature readings into several ranges, each of which is represented by a colour map. The system can determine the precise region based on the thermal camera photos recorded, and the proposed system can then follow a trail to see what sort of malfunctioning is there in the appliances or wiring.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network based Leaf Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: India is known as an agricultural country where about 41.49% of the labor force depends on agri culture.
