articleTitle: Design of Building Digital Dynamic Structural Deformation Monitoring and Evaluation System Based on Joint Programming
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This article focuses on the research of the single epoch solution method of joint programming data, as well as the analysis and prediction of the deformation amount of the monitoring point. In addition, the application of this method in data processing of deformation monitoring system and the influence of data correlation on deformation accuracy are also discussed. This paper also explains various methods of analyzing and predicting deformation, and proposes the overall variance method to analyze the deformation, and uses the Kalman filter method to predict the deformation value. The trial calculation results show that these methods are feasible. Finally, this article designs a set of joint programming automatic deformation monitoring system, including software function design, database implementation, etc., and analyzes the system's safety and reliability.

articleTitle: Application of Multimedia Technology in Health Service Management System under the Background of Big Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Health service management is an important task in the development of my country's current medical and health system. Under the background of the application and development of big data technology, and under the condition of fully understanding the basic status of my country's health service management, appropriate and effective The improvement and optimization strategy of the health service management model is of great significance to support and ensure that my country's modern health service management work successfully obtains the optimal expected effect in the specific organization and development process. This paper studies the application of multimedia technology in health service management based on big data fusion technology.

articleTitle: Fusion Modeling and Heterogeneous Simulation of Big Data Technology in 5G Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In order to continuously improve the service capabilities of the 5G communication network and promote the formation of a high-quality and efficient service structure, the R&D team and technical personnel have gradually tried to apply big data technology to the 5G communication network and achieved certain results. In this context, the article takes the application of big data technology as a starting point, systematically discusses the application method of big data technology in 5G communication network, and studies the integration modeling and heterogeneous simulation of big data technology in 5G communication network based on deep learning. The simulation results show that the heterogeneous network improves big data by 6.6%.

articleTitle: Sentimental Analysis through Speech and text for IMDB Dataset
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In the advanced innovative present reality, most of the public are depending on different surveys for different utilizations and different products. Thus, to examine these audits and comprehend whether they are supporting or refuting about, opinion investigation can be utilized. The days for the remark surveys are currently disappearing and everybody is keen on hearing the audits so as they need not stop their functions. Thus, a slant investigation that does both through brief snippet and text can be used to complete work in sound. Along these lines, in this exploration paper, different Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models like Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest, and Multi-Layer Perceptron are used. Additionally, as of to change over voice to a message, a google API and a deep learning technique are used and best of two is exhibited and afterward sentiment analysis on those texts is performed and finally the sentiment (i.e., positive, or negative) of the speech is obtained. All these processes are carried out in real-time.

articleTitle: Impact of Work Function and Silicon Thickness on 3-D Analytical Model of Gate All Around Field Effect Transistor
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this work, by using different work functions and silicon thickness to observe the performance of gate-all-around field-effect transistor (GAA-FET) multigate by keeping channel length 30nm. In this paper, the n-type gate-all-around field-effect transistor (n-GAA-FET) was developed by using the parabolic and Poisson equation. Further, by variation of different silicon thickness and taking suitable gate work functions (4.6eV and 4.7eV) observed the performance of the n-GAA-FET device. Further, it is observed best performance of the device by reducing the dimension of silicon thickness (tSi), using appropriate work function on different parameters such as threshold voltage(VTH), ON and OFF current, drain induced barrier lowering (DIBL). The proposed model exhibits increase drain current (10E5)by reducing silicon thickness and improved leakage current(10E11), the optimal threshold voltage of 0.33V, decline drain induced barrier lowering, improved subthreshold slope of 63 mV/decade.

articleTitle: A Novel Deep Neural Network Model for Computer Network Intrusion Detection Considering Connection Efficiency of Network Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: A novel deep neural network model for computer network intrusion detection considering connection efficiency of network systems is studied in this manuscript. In intrusion detection system, intrusion features and normal user behavior are defined as the parameter set, and immune genetic algorithm is introduced to search the whole measurement space to optimize the measurement parameter set. For network-based IDS, the console is installed on the host, and the detector collecting network information is installed on other hosts in the network, the novel deep neural network is integrated to construct the efficient analysis. In the experiment part, the performance is tested and in the conclusion part, the performance of the model is summarized.

articleTitle: Real-time data transmission of cross-border e-commerce based on big data considering data complexity
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Real-time data transmission of the cross-border e-commerce based on big data considering data complexity is studied in the paper. Wireless communication technology has been applied to many measurement and control sites and plays a great role. Because wireless data communication does not need wiring, it has fast layout and good expansibility, and has incomparable convenience compared with the wired data communication. Considering this basis feature, this paper will then consider the integration of the mentioned technique to revise the traditional data complexity estimation model. The function of the terminal device layer is to provide a consistent access interface for the kernel to call, so that the kernel does not have to consider the type of specific terminal when operating the serial port. With this theoretical basis, the novel safety guarantee model is considered to finalize the big data system. The experiment and application scenarios are selected as the cross-border e-commerce systems.

articleTitle: 3D Animation Modeling Measurement Analysis Based on Computer Aided Node Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper analyzes the design and modeling measurement of three-dimensional animation based on computer-aided node mining. First, with the development of computer technology, animation technology has gradually evolved from one-dimensional technology to current three-dimensional technology. 3dsMax computer software is a widely used 3D animation modeling software. Based on the binary tree node classification and mining analysis of computer-aided modeling, high dynamic mapping applications, layered rendering settings, photon file applications that can store light energy transmission information, In some areas, dynamic systems and other aspects are applied, and the modeling results show that the modeling accuracy has increased by 6.7%

articleTitle: Characteristraziation of Components of Photonics based CW radar system using OptiSys Software
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to simulate the photonics-based radar using OptiSystem software for the understanding of real-world radar system and accordingly hardware parameters can be designed. The continuous wave radar based on photonics is simulated. The generation of RF frequency has been simulated with the help of CW Laser. The reflection part is simulated through MATLAB co-simulation with OptiSystem. The receiving part is also simulated. This whole simulation is assumed will be used for real-world conditions.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Neural Network Classification Model for Multi Labeled Electricity Consumption Data Set
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Multi-level Hierarchical Fuzzy classification technique is significant classification model based on fuzzy membership value. The results of classification rules are obtained using MHFRB classification algorithm which has been used in Neural Networks technique for multi labelled data Classification. The proposed MHFRB classification algorithm is constructed on the improvement of a simple semantic Fuzzy Model in a hierarchical structure. The Fuzzy neural network classification model has been used to analysis the regional wise electricity consumption data for different multi labelled dataset. The results of the model provide the need of the electricity energy resources and accuracy of the classification model is considerably improved. Fuzzy Neural Networks technique is used to get a compact and accurate model at multiple levels. In this paper, the proposed methods are used to validate the Classification Model with the multi-label datasets and demonstrated that there is a considerable enhancement in performance when compared with the existing methods in the literature.

articleTitle: Study on Intelligent Image Analysis of Bitmap Vectorization Conversion in Graphic Design with Pattern Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper takes the intelligent image analysis of the vectorized conversion of bitmaps in graphic design as the main line. Aiming at the situation that it is not easy to make three-dimensional pictures in graphic design, the intelligent image analysis algorithm is used to extract, analyze and classify the features of bitmaps. Based on the Bézier curve-based graphics boundary line extraction, graphic boundary line extraction correction and simple color graphic boundary line extraction models, use Excel for corresponding data processing, and use Photoshop, Matlab and other software to extract the graphic boundary lines. Opencv software the fitted line was tested, and the result showed that the conversion efficiency of bitmap vectorization increased by 9.1%.

articleTitle: Analysis of Parameter Estimation of an Electric Bicycle Using IoT with Data Analytics Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Due to its environmental benefits and zero-emissions characteristics, electric bicycles are attracting more and more attention around the world For the purpose of developing an electric bicycle with high performance, a simulation is conducted taking into account the rider's mass, wind speed, and slope. A dynamic equation is used to simulate the operation of this bicycle in certain operating conditions. The dynamic equations are solved using Matlab-Simulink, simulations are validated by comparing experimental results with those from LabVIEW.

articleTitle: DHL: Dynamic Honey Link for Identification of Asymmetric Attacks at Application Layer
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Asymmetric DDoS attacks have become very complicated to deal with because of the use of several IP addresses in these types of attacks. Different strategies are used by attacker to get his objective of forcing unavailability of targeted server. Big size of file is needed with higher transfer rate so that the targeted website could be hanged for legitimate customer. Dynamic honey link is used to avoid identification from sophisticated DDoS attacking tools. A novel mechanism is developed here for detection of asymmetric attack. Parameters used in this mechanism are verified applying correlation coefficient and p-values.

articleTitle: Prediction of Water Quality using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Water quality prediction plays a significant role in the management and planning of water resources. It is critical for identifying the status of water bodies, obtaining information regarding the implementation of specified interventions, and assessing the effectiveness of implemented measures. Additionally, increase in urbanisation, construction, agricultural operations, industrial uses, and natural processes have harmed the quality of surface water and groundwater around the world, as well as its consequences on human health. Utilizing the water quality characteristics as input, an artificial neural network (ANN) technique is used to forecast water quality metrics. To find the best predictions, different input combinations and performance criteria are attempted. The results show that the measured and calculated parameters have low error and strong correlation values. These findings suggest that ANNs have a lot of potential for predicting water quality metrics.

articleTitle: A Compact Multi Band Antenna for Military and Modern Wireless Communication Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This work presents a small multi band antenna that use the etching slots approach in radiating element. The suggested antenna is meant to mark two separate frequencies: 7500 MHz, 9000 MHz, and a wide band from 22.4 GHz to 28.9 GHz for modern wireless communication applications. The antenna's total dimensions are <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$13\times 12.8\times 1.6\ \text{mm}^{3}$</tex> in the constructed prototype. At −10 dB, the bandwidths are 221 MHz (7.34-7.57 GHz), 230 MHz (8.85-9.08 GHz) and 6500 MHz (22.4-28.9 GHz) at various frequencies. As a result of the findings, the suggested multi band antenna may be utilized for military, radar communications, and is a promising contender for modern wireless mobile communication applications.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Study on Photocatalytic Degradation of Pollutants in Water Treatment from the Perspectives of Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper studies the computer aided study on the photocatalytic degradation of pollutants in water treatment from the perspectives of data mining. How to effectively analyze the models of the water treatment, the computer aided methods should be combined. Especially, the novel data collection and analytic models. In this paper, the preparation of nitrogen-doped titanium dioxide nanorods and its photocatalytic degradation of water treatment pollutants are studied based on computer-aided research. The performance of the proposed model is tested on different scenarios to validate the efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the Architecture of Digital Agriculture Public Service Platform Based on Web Service Chain
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In recent years, the use of architecture to build information systems has gradually become the mainstream trend. This article focuses on the tedious programming of professional IT personnel to build application systems for combined Web services, and it is difficult for ordinary users to complete alone. Explore the application of workflow technology to Web services to build a service chain Methods and development of service chain construction tools, through simple drag-and-drop dynamic combination of services on-demand in the visual interface to meet application requirements, reduce the difficulty of application construction, and improve system development efficiency. To achieve the purpose of quick assembly service and meeting business needs, and to verify the feasibility and reliability of the method through the example of service chain construction in the Shanghai Digital Agriculture Public Service Platform.

articleTitle: Brand Visual Image Design of Rural Tourist Attractions Based on Super-Resolution Reconstruction and Image Scaling Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Based on the super-resolution reconstruction and image scaling technology, this paper studies the brand visual Xinang design of rural tourist attractions, from the investigation of tourists' visual experience needs and intuitive feelings, the positioning of the brand image of accommodation, the mining and extraction of visual image design elements, and the design of visual image Research from a system perspective. A multi-frame super-resolution reconstruction algorithm for mapping between convex sets is proposed. The algorithm is based on the active viewpoint degradation model. After implementing the fuzzy kernel estimation steps of image registration and blind deblurring based on the SIFT algorithm, a scalable image progressive watermarking algorithm based on DWT-SVD is proposed, which can be used for scalable images the copyright protection is of great significance to the security technology of scalable images.

articleTitle: State-of-the-art digital technologies on garden landscape intelligent monitoring and topology optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: State-of-the-art digital technologies on garden landscape intelligent monitoring and topology optimization is studied in this paper. In our algorithm, each basic image is independent, and each image is associated with its own directory. There is no need to read irrelevant directories, so that it can be compatible with other images. In this method, the object light and the reference light involved in coherent interference have the same characteristics except that the incident angle is symmetric with the normal line of the recording pattern, hence, the topology can be optimized with the referring of the related models. Through the experimental research, the robustness is proven.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Reasoning Engine Based on Legal Framework Network Database
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Based on the legal framework network database, this paper designs an intelligent reasoning engine based on the theoretical framework of the computational dictionary compilation project from the University of California, Berkeley. The framework is classified and revised, and the database contains three sub-libraries: the framework library, the vocabulary library and the example sentence library. Each frame in the frame library contains the basic information describing the frame, the frame elements that make up the frame, the word elements that belong to a frame, the semantic type corresponding to the frame elements, and the relationship between the frames. This article deals with the framework library, realize the automatic generation of the legal framework ontology through the relevant information under each framework, and improve the law based on intelligent reasoning, increasing the efficiency by 9.6%.

articleTitle: A Novel Attendance System based on face recognition using Haar-cascade and SVM
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Automated Face Recognition technology (AFR) has led to numerous advancements in the ever-changing world. Smart Attendance utilizes real-time Face Recognition as an actual-world solution that is integrated with everyday activities that help manage students' attendance. For this Automatic attendance system. LBPH and Haar-cascade are used to recognize and detect the image with low-rate error accuracy and for fast calculation of the image recognition. In this process the images were captured from the surveillance and recognized with low error rate.

articleTitle: Selecting Ideal Indian Post Office Saving Scheme through Multi-Criteria Decision Support System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Investing money is a good habit as it ensures financial security to investors at present and in the future as well. Depositing money merely in any saving a/c may not fulfill the financial objectives of a depositor. It is always a wise decision to invest money in any of the saving schemes in banks or Indian Post Offices. The money earned from regular investments usually provides financial security and income. But it is always not too easy to identify in which saving scheme a person should invest. In this paper, five Indian post office saving schemes are considered with their associated attributes and then the TOPSIS method is applied to identify the best saving schemes among the experimented schemes. TOPSIS method compares the set of alternatives with their associated and identifying weights for each and every criterion. Through this approach, the ideal choice among the experimented alternatives can be determined.

articleTitle: The Application Strategy of Computer Technology Based on Game Data in Optimal Pricing of Bundled Sales in Retail Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The enhancement of cooperation between different industries and the sharing of advanced science and technology have blurred the boundary between the service industry and the manufacturing industry, and the expansion of the manufacturing industry and the retail industry into the service industry has become more obvious. Construct the optimal pricing strategy for the product from the perspective of the retail enterprise, based on the game model, the main body includes the manufacturer, the retailer, and the consumer. The retrospective method is used to examine the retailer's optimal behavior, and then the manufacturer's optimal pricing is reversed. Model, and finally arrive at an appropriate bundling sales strategy. This paper studies the application of computer technology based on game data in the optimal pricing of retail enterprise bundling sales.

articleTitle: Brain-Computer Interface Analysis and Data Mining Measurement of Communicative Awareness in Online English Guiding in Colleges from a Cross-Cultural Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: With the acceleration of the globalization process, international exchanges are becoming more frequent. As one of the main lingua franca in the world, English has become more widely used. This paper analyzes the brain-computer interface analysis and data mining measurement of English communicative awareness in big vocational universities based on a cross-cultural perspective. Because of the rapid development of my country's economy, the rapid growth of diplomatic relations has put up with higher satisfication for our foreign language education. Finally, with data mining analysis of the construction of English teaching mode in big vocational universities from a cross-cultural perspective, the importance of cross-cultural communication awareness is analyzed through a data mining model based on principal component analysis, which improves communication efficiency by 6.7%.

articleTitle: Quantum Computer Assisted Dynamics Modeling for the Unified Configuration Analysis of Cultivated Land and Ecological Land with Data Classification Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Quantum computer assisted dynamics modeling for the unified configuration analysis of cultivated land and ecological land with data classification algorithms is studied in this paper. In the ecological restoration strategy, planting plants with strong heavy metal accumulation capacity can enable ecological land to complete the restoration of damaged farmland in a short time, hence, the computer data collection system is combined to obtain the efficient data sets. Furthermore, the data classification models are combined for the comprehensive analysis. For the dynamics, the novel computer system is designed to validate the model. Comparison simulation is conducted to show the results.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of DNN Models for Skin Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Malignant melanoma, the most dangerous form of skin cancer, has become more common in recent years. The persistent global increase in this cancer, as well as the high medical costs and death rate, have made early detection of this malignancy a priority. Melanoma survival and cure are directly proportional to its thickness; if it can be found early, the survival rate will be enhanced. Despite the fact that significant progress has been achieved in the identification of skin malignancies, there are still significant issues. In comparison to the naked eye, computer-based detection systems can enhance the diagnosis rate of melanoma by 5 – 30 percent. Because visual perception frequently contains flaws, the need for a second viewpoint with greater precision and consistency is underlined. On the other side, it minimizes the tasks and responsibilities that physicians are responsible for. Many studies have been conducted in the area of automated melanoma detection. The potential benefits of such investigations are enormous and unquantifiable. Furthermore, the challenges are numerous, and fresh contributions in this field are greatly valued. However, it is widely known that more reliable and consistent detection methods necessitate a higher level of accuracy. The goal of this paper is to provide a skin cancer diagnosis system that can automatically identify lesions as malignant or benign. Preprocessing, segmentation, feature extraction and selection, and classification are some of the methods used in an automated skin cancer diagnosis.

articleTitle: Agricultural product B2C e-commerce supply chain management based on the intelligence of United Logistics Information
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: My country is a big country in agricultural production. Affected by factors such as geography, population, and natural environment, my country's agricultural production is mainly based on the small-scale peasant economy. In this way, the level of productivity is low, the efficiency and benefits are relatively backward, and the response to market information is relatively slow. In order to build a modern agricultural production system, the acquisition of agricultural product market information is important, and the emergence of the Internet, especially the rapid development of e-commerce in other industries, has brought new opportunities to the modernization of agriculture. This paper studies the agricultural product B2C e-commerce supply chain management based on the intelligentization of e-commerce and logistics information.

articleTitle: Research on the Combination of 3D Printing Technology and Computer Aided Industrial Design
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Computer and 3D printing technology are integrated in all aspects of modern life. The creation and application of 3D printing technology and the use of computers to assist industrial production are manifestations of the world's technological progress. Combining the two, 3D printing designers use computers to design, will further improve production efficiency. Based on this, this article first elaborates on the principles of computer-aided industrial design and 3D printing technology, and then analyzes the methods and effects of combining computer-aided industrial design and 3D printing technology. In order to provide relevant people for communication and reference.

articleTitle: Analysis of Multi-dimensional Image Fusion and Joint Information Mining in Landscape Design with Vision Information Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Analysis of multi-dimensional image fusion and the ioint information mining in landscape design with vision information mining is studied in the paper. In the question discussed, the images have different spatial resolutions. For example, before making a decision using a distributed detection structure, the targets detected between the sensors must undergo very complex correlation processing. Before starting to merge the images. It must be ensured that each pixel in the related image corresponds to each other, and image matching is the process of comparing these differences to find their similarities. Hence, the latest fusion model is considered to achieve this goal. Through the experimental analysis, the performance is validated.

articleTitle: Online Interactive Data Extraction and Intelligent Analysis of College Vocal Music Courses Oriented to Mobile Android Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper studies the extraction and intelligent analysis of online interactive data of college vocal music courses oriented to mobile Android platforms. First, it understands the traditional learning mode of college bel canto vocal music teaching courses, uses the Internet of Things sensor network to extract data from college vocal music courses, and then based on Neural network algorithms, many-to-one interactive data extraction for the teaching of sight singing, chorus, and music appreciation, all require teachers to use a variety of methods to teach music in a sound and emotional manner.

articleTitle: Analysis of Proximity Coupled Micro Strip Feed Linear Antenna Array for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper presents the microstrip linear array with proximity coupled microstrip feed. This paper presents the design and analysis of a proximity coupled microstrip feed linear patch array and its radiation properties are reported. The prposed array with the feed structure is modeled and simulated in the method of moments based CST microwave studio software. The array is compact and is resonsnt at 28 GHz frequency which is used in 5G technologies (24.25 – 29.5 GHz)The array is compact and is resonsnt at 28 GHz frequency which is used in 5G technologies. There are six number of square shaped patch elements are placed and are excited by a series of patch strip elements. This antenna exhibits reflection coefficient of -23 dB and radiates broadside with maximum radiation perpendicular to the patch surface elements. This antenna gives return loss of 18dB and radiates broadside with maximum radiation perpendicular to the patch elements. The proposed array is used in jammer and MIMO radar applications.

articleTitle: A Construction and Control Implementation of ProtoType Drives
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The paper includes construction and control implementation of prototype drive, FPGA, and FPGA controller design. Two single-band control procedures and novel double-band strategies were proposed, and an adequate way of carrying out the control was devised. This means that an FPGA is the stage supported by the solid, unsurprising way it operates and the rationality of such a chip in carrying out rational control plans.

articleTitle: Application of Augmented Reality and Meta-quantum Analysis Technology in the Art Design of Cartoon Characters
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper designs and implements a cartoon character design system based on augmented reality and meta-quantum analysis, so that children can create a three-dimensional cartoon scene from their two-dimensional hand-drawn drawings and perform interactive operations in the augmented reality environment. In order to enhance the realistic visual experience in the virtual scene, meta-quantum analysis and behavior control are performed on the characters in the 3D virtual animation design. Create a three-dimensional virtual animation character model in POS ER software, create a three-dimensional virtual animation character skeleton in 3D software and skin the bones to achieve animation character modeling. The skeletal animation technology is used to simulate the movement behavior of the character in 3D software, adjust the movement and drive the bones.

articleTitle: Development and Realization of Scientific Research Management Information System Based on Process Attempt and Agile Development
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper studies the development and implementation of scientific research management information systems based on process attempts and agile development, and summarizes the related concepts of traditional proj ect management systems. Secondly, it introduces the characteristics of process attempts and agile development management techniques. The process attempts to analyze with agile development technology and apply this technology to the scientific and technological plan project management system. From system requirements analysis to specific design, as well as the specific realization ideas and flowcharts of key parts of the system, the design and realization process of a scientific research project management system based on process attempts and agile development technology are described, and the efficiency is increased by 4.69%.

articleTitle: Data Collection and Analysis of College Students' Consciousness Information Based on Brain-Computer Connection Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: College students are a vital force for the development of the motherland and social progress. Ensuring the safety of college students is an important part of maintaining the stability of the campus and the harmonious society. The safety awareness of college students has become increasingly prominent, and the level of safety awareness of college students will directly affect the harmonious development of themselves, the school and the society. The brain is the most complex organ of the human body, and different brain regions are in charge of different functions of the human body. Once the brain is damaged, it will cause different degrees of damage to the brain nerve function. Based on brain-computer connection modeling, this paper studies the data collection and analysis of college students' consciousness state information.

Author Keywords: State of Consciousness of College Students

articleTitle: Application of Smart Image Processing Technology in Feature Extraction of Glass Artistic Style Patterns
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: With the emerging development of the digital signal processing technology, the image information can be analyzed from different perspectives. Hence, this paper studies the application of smart image processing technology in feature extraction of glass artistic style patterns. Information entropy reflects the amount of information contained in the image. The larger the information entropy, the more information the image contains. Therefore, the vector transform model is considered for the image feature analysis and adjustment work. The glass style is considered as the pattern to further analyze the image feature. The model is tested on Matlab and compared with the other latest models. The results have reflected that the proposed model can extract the features effectively.

articleTitle: A Framework for Improving the Core Literacy Capability of University Sports Distance Guidance Based on the Allocation of Intelligent Video Processing Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Based on the allocation of intelligent video processing resources, this paper studies the core literacy improvement framework of college sports remote guidance. The content of the teaching design is simulated competitions, traditional sports inheritance, and personalized sports method innovation, which allows students to participate in teaching design, daily sports participation, and innovation. During the participation, the individual's coordination ability, organization ability, adaptability and innovation ability will be continuously improved, and the future career is developed. Using intelligent video analysis algorithm, MySQL and remote transmission network improves the efficiency of the framework of remote guidance of college sports by 6.5%

articleTitle: Analysis of a Joint Data Security Architecture Integrating Artificial Intelligence and Cloud Computing in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This article analyzes the analysis of the joint data security architecture that integrates artificial intelligence and cloud computing in the era of big data. The article discusses and analyzes the integrated applications of big data, artificial intelligence and cloud computing. As an important part of big data security protection, joint data security Protecting the technical architecture is not only related to the security of joint data in the big data era, but also has an important impact on the overall development of the data era. Based on this, the thesis takes the big data security and joint data security protection technical architecture as the research content, and through a simple explanation of big data security, it then conducts detailed research on the big data security and joint data security protection technical architecture from five aspects and thinking.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence Algorithm and Deductive Database in Special Scene Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The article discusses the basic functions of the special scene recognition system, the network protocol and the special scene recognition information database MIB. The ERC+ method of deductive database design is discussed, and an application example is given. First, a behavior recognition model that combines skeleton information with convolutional network is proposed. Secondly, a novel spatiotemporal convolution module is designed in the network and the attention mechanism is innovatively introduced to model the spatiotemporal correlation of the human skeleton movement. Finally, the article also analyzes the adaptability of the deductive database to the application of special scene recognition, which is very beneficial to the design and maintenance of the network system.

articleTitle: Research on the RAIM Algorithm of Beidou Satellite Navigation System Based on Robust Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Based on the application of Beidou satellite navigation system in civil aviation, the basic theories and methods of RAIM availability prediction are studied. On the basis of theoretical research, Beidou RAIM availability prediction software is independently designed and developed to realize RAIM availability prediction for airports, air routes and regions. The number of visible satellites and DOP (factor of precision) under GPS and multi-mode GPS/GLONASS/Galileo systems are simulated, and the horizontal protection threshold (HPL) that measures the availability of the RAIM algorithm is compared, and the fault detection rate under these two systems is compared with Troubleshooting rate. Specific methods for tropospheric error, satellite clock error, receiver clock error, and multipath effect error.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Equipment and Physiology Online System Mode in Practice of Medical Students
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper studies the application of intelligent equipment and physiology online teaching mode in medical students’ practice. Through the real experience of the teaching practice process, the advantages of online teaching are summarized: the high integration of teaching resources, the repeated learning mode anytime and anywhere, the network and dataization of the supervision of the teaching process, etc.; the teacher's PBL evaluation of the students is in the “pertinence of the speech” and “improving comprehensive ability” are statistically significant (P<0.05); the difference in the scores of the seven subjects of basic medicine in the curriculum reform class is not statistically significant (P>0.05).

articleTitle: A Gesticulation Superintend Arm with Arduino IDE
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In today's era where technological advancement is at its peak, the need for sophisticated and ergonomic machinery is rapidly increasing. With the growing involvement of robots in several fields and the automation of factories, it can be inferred that robotics is the future. Through this paper, robotic arm that can be controlled with the means of human hand gestures is proposed. To achieve this, an accelerometer and a gyro sensor module are used. These modules each have three axes, making them appropriate for sensing hand deflection. To make reliable data, the values obtained are processed using mathematical coMPUtations, scaled, and filtered. This data is utilized to control the arm's movement Because all of the processing happens at the same time, the robotic arm's movement is synchronized with the human arm's motions. The Arduino IDE platform was used to create this robotic arm. Finally, the findings are examined.

articleTitle: Film and Television Special Effects Production Based on Modern Technology: from the Perspective of Statistical Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Based on statistical machine learning, this paper studies film and television special effects production under the background of modern technology. First, it introduces the new challenges of film and television post-production technology, which requires a new development direction. Then based on modern technology analysis, the role of special effects production technology in film and television post-production is analyzed, and it is necessary to strengthen related research. Therefore, starting with the concept of film and television production, analyzing the technology of film and television post-production special effects according to the specific process and relationship of film and television production, and explaining its application in two-dimensional and three-dimensional animation, it has become the key research content of the current film and television post-production work.

articleTitle: Computer network security system construction based on QoS analysis and intelligent total identification
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Computer network security system construction based on the QoS analysis and intelligent total identification is studied in this manuscript. There are a variety of safety devices with discovery capabilities in the linkage system. If their alarm events are not summarized and sorted out, it will lead to confusion in the linkage system. Therefore, the classification of various alarm events constitutes the basis of the linkage system. Since in the 5th generation mobile communication system, the interface between the terminal device and the service network is the most vulnerable point, how to achieve the more reliable network access security capability is a crucial issue in the 5G system security solution. Hence, in the designed model, Mrtg tool provides the monitoring function of the network flow. It can provide more specific information about the network flow, such as the start and end time of the network flow, and the number of bytes transmitted by the network flow. All the models are fused into the comprehensive platform to validate the performance.

articleTitle: Virtualization Scene Mining and Streaming Media Integration for the Information Technology Guiders' Comprehensive Development
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Following the advancement of the basic information and the deepening of a new round of accurate revolution, the status of information and technology guiding in primary and secondary schools has become increasingly prominent. As one of the main bodies of information and technology teaching practice, the promotion of the information-science teachers' professional quality is currently an urgent problem to be solved. This paper studies the virtual scene mining and streaming media integration of the career development of information-science teachers, and analyzes the different application scenarios of the development path of information-science teachers in the era of big data. The novel technologies are combined for reviewing the latest methods of the IT and the combination for the comprehensive development modelling are both studied. The simulations also show the performance.

articleTitle: Attitude-assisted correction framework for cheerleading based on visual tracking technology
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Attitude-assisted correction framework for general cheerleading based on visual tracking technology is presented in this paper. In the proposed model, the contributions are focused on the three aspects. (1) A tracking method based on basic diverse examples of learning is proposed. Drift is mitigated by relaxing the selection area of the naive positive sample. (2) The distinction analysis is one of basic pattern recognition research important branches, its essential target is through to the known data sample training and the study, the mentioned ideas are used to construct the novel models. (3) The comprehensive evaluation model based on the data mining framework is discussed, the core fuzzy clustering model is presented. The simulation is also well presented to show the performance of the idea. The future research plan is summarized in the final for references.

articleTitle: Design of Novel Media Communication Platform Based on the Combination of Audio and Short Video Signal
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This manuscript studies the design of novel media communication platform based on the combination of audio and short video signal. As an application framework, website can integrate data resources, network resources and application systems to serve users in the form of information management platform and unified user interface. Online news dissemination has high-speed, multimedia, interactivity, database and other performance advantages in information dissemination that traditional media have never had. This paper proposes the novel framework combining the audio and short video signal processing to design the efficient data processing unit. The application scenarios are then validated through testing.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Judgment System for Appreciation of Film and Television Art Media in the Internet Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Based on the Internet environment, this paper studies the computer-aided evaluation system for media appreciation of film and television art. Firstly, from borrowing others' art appreciation methods to innovating media appreciation, then it analyzes the gradual transformation of the aesthetic appreciation of film and television art to new media, multimedia, cross-media, cloud media, self-media, and computer-aided judgment based on technologies such as JAVA and Web. The system makes the form of film and television art appreciation more personalized and humanized, enhances the initiative of appreciators to participate, strengthens the intelligence of art appreciation, and improves the accuracy of judgment by 7.6%

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach to Classifying Crime Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Big data opens up new possibilities in a variety of areas. In some instances, having a large dataset available may be beneficial. However, processing an Exabyte of data in its entirety is difficult. This article uses Hybrid Enhanced Artificial Bee Colony to create a hybrid algorithm for obtaining timely and actionable knowledge to expand and use comprehensive extensive data modelling systems and analytics algorithms. Hybrid Enhanced Artificial Bee Colony (HEABC) algorithm Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifiers have been contemplatedto build a hybrid algorithm for obtaining timely and actionable information. Resolving this issue would permit high exactitude data classification, which is particularly important for Big Data, to be completed in a reasonable amount of time. The hybrid algorithm computes an s. The hybrid algorithm simultaneously seeks the kernel function's form. The concept of bees inspired the hybrid EABC algorithm. During the algorithm's implementation, some bees alter the shape of their kernel function to correspond to the particle with the most significant classification accuracy. The proposed EABC algorithm is a mathematical formula that reduces the time spent creating SVM classifiers, which is crucial for solving the big data classification problem. SVM classification work focused on the hybrid EABC algorithm. Experimentation has shown that the Big Data classification approaches provided are adequate.

articleTitle: Design and Interaction of Scientific Research Management Online System Based on Agile Development and Crawler Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper studies the development and implementation of scientific research management information systems based on crawler mining and agile development, and summarizes the related concepts of traditional project management systems. Secondly, it introduces the characteristics of crawler mining and agile development management techniques. The crawler mining to analyze with agile development technology and apply this technology to the scientific and technological plan project management system. From system requirements analysis to specific design, as well as the specific realization ideas and flowcharts of key parts of the system, the design and realization process of a scientific research project management system based on crawler mining and agile development technology are described, and the efficiency is increased by 7.45%.

articleTitle: Fault Tolerant Adders With Low Overheads For Smart Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this paper the authors analyse different adder designs with respect to the extent of fault. If the fault is localized the fault free part of the tree may be brought in use thereby improving the throughput. The results indicate the suitability of Ling parallel prefix adders for implementation of fault tolerant adders due to the fact that the fault effects the even or odd part of the tree and leaves the odd or even part fault free. A design for online error detection is proposed employing the Ling parallel prefix adders as the adjacent columns compute independently. Then the design is used in the implementation of the 15–4 compressor of a Wallace Tree Multiplier so that it has the capacity to detect faults. Further, a Ling parallel prefix adder with fault tolerance is designed to augment the online error detection design. This is compared with the existing designs and it shows an improvement in delay of about 30% compared to RCA-TMR scheme and 50% when compared to the traditional Prefix adders with fault tolerance. There is a significant improvement in ADP & PDP values. Finally, a scheme to mitigate overheads using approximate computation is proposed.

articleTitle: Cooperative FFT Modeling of Sparse Analysis of Traditional Opera Audio Signals and Piano Impromptu Accompaniment
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper studies the cooperative FFT modeling of traditional opera audio signal sparse analysis and piano impromptu accompaniment. By analyzing the structural characteristics of the over-complete atomic library used in traditional opera speech signal sparse decomposition, an improved signal sparse decomposition algorithm is proposed. According to the characteristics of the voice signal, the algorithm reduces the audio signal of piano improvisation based on the sparse decomposition realized by the FFT algorithm, thus not only further improving the decomposition speed, but also expressing the voice signal in a more sparse form, combined with the FFT of piano improvisation accompaniment Modeling improves effectiveness by 7.3%.

articleTitle: Energy efficient workflow scheduling in Dynamic Voltage Frequency scaling enabled cloud using Metaheuristic approach
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Dynamic voltage Frequency Scaling is widely used in data centers for reducing the power consumption. When DVFS is integrated into cloud workflow scheduling, the work is allotted to the virtual machines that has minimal operating frequency. Instead, it will be better if it is optimally allocated based on the overall list of VMs present and the entire requirement. To achieve this, Memetic Dynamic Voltage/Frequency scaling (MDVFS) algorithm is proposed where the task assigned is redistributed to less utilized processors and free processors are released. The experimental results show reduction in power consumption by 30–50 % for different parallel applications.

articleTitle: Car tire noise transmission path and signal attenuation modeling analysis: from data simulation perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Car tire noise transmission path and signal attenuation modeling analysis from data simulation perspective is conducted in this paper. Noise is accurately and quantitatively estimated, so actual measurement has become an important method for studying tire noise characteristics. In this study, the focus will be on the signal processing. This paper uses the various excellent characteristics of optical fiber channel to transmit the original analog echo signal of the radar remotely, so as to install the intermediate frequency sampling extension, general signal processing extension. With the integration of the complex and efficient signal collection and processing, the proposed model is applied to the noise detection scenarios. The simulation is conducted under different types of tires and the comparison analysis of the noise detection performance is considered.

articleTitle: Intelligent Segmentation Framework and Data Hierarchy of Chinese Language and Literature Based on Semantic Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Based on semantic recognition, this paper studies the intelligent segmentation framework and data layering of Chinese language and literature. First of all, in this paper, in the study of predicting Chinese semantic word-building patterns, based on binary classification Logistic regression and naive Bayes to construct Chinese sentence segmentation patterns for intelligent simulation experiments. Then the eight types of data in the annotated corpus are grouped in pairs, and each sample set is divided into data stratification, so that the two-class Logistic regression model and the naive Bayes model are first based on the training set of each group to learn semantic word formation rules., And then predict the semantic word formation mode on the test set of each group, and the result shows that the sentence segmentation efficiency is increased by 6.5%

articleTitle: Intelligentization of film and television post-production based on complex image processing and scene switching algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Intelligentization of the film and television post-pro duction based on the complex image processing and scene switching algorithms is studied in the paper. At present, the film and television media is in a period of rapid development, and new media formats are constantly emerging. The emergence of high-definition television HDTV, the rapid development of the network puts forward new requirements for film and television post-production, in order to adapt to these changes, various software manufacturers continue to improve software functions and keep pace with the market. The development of computer virtual technology and the application of the design field have caused a fundamental change in the traditional design process. Therefore, the handover procedure caused by any delay should be minimized, which has attracted the attention of many researchers and seeking new solutions. The novel solutions are proposed model improve the complex image processing and scene switching algorithm performance. Through the verification, the performance is guaranteed.

articleTitle: A Study of Identity Threat using CyberThreat Defense Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Many commercial organizations that run their business on web interface, with zero down time is questionable due to the vulnerability in their entire commercialization process. The reason behind such unsuccessful event or disrupt in the process depends on the conditions such as variations of traffic, authentication failure, difficulty in detection of botnets, violations of rules in accessing information and other breeches on security. Cognitive Intelligence is a specific topic to alleviate such abnormalities on data related to secure transaction for resolving contemporary issues occurring in due process of various web-based applications. Cyber Threat Defense (CTD) is an approach to deal with the mentioned issues to protect threats on advance, doubtful client progress and rule violations, on organization information. Confrontation reaction deals with the real time notification of ongoing application and the same can be controlled by CTD Incident Response. Python Library map are used to simulate the introspection of security concern on organization's information.

articleTitle: A Survey of E-bidding System using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: With the increasing use of the internet, the e-auction system is becoming popular. E-Auction is an efficient e-commerce system that allows buyers and sellers to make a transaction through online platforms. Blockchain technology and smart contracts are being used in an e-auction to make it secure, transparent, and decentralized In this paper, we use different bidding techniques that use cryptography to ensure security and to keep private information confidential of any participants in the auction. Furthermore, we have explained the concept of public bidding and sealed bidding which will be used in E-auction, we have explained UAE that is used to keep stakeholders identity autonomous, the paper also explains the hash functions which provides the advantage of encryption and decentralization Thus blockchain and smart contracts make it more efficient and secure compared to other traditional and e-auction systems.

articleTitle: Movie Box Office Prediction System Based on Multi-Architecture Neural Network and Fish School Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In recent decades, the film industry has developed rapidly, both in terms of the number of films and the production cost, showing an increasing trend year by year. The huge scale of the film market and high film production costs have made box office forecasts an urgent concern for the film industry. As early as the 1980s, the industry began to study the problem of movie box office forecasts. Throughout the empirical analysis of the relevant reflection that effect the movie box office, the box office prediction model is constructed. This paper builds a movie box office prediction system based on multi-architecture neural network and fish school algorithm to make intelligent predictions for different types of movies.

articleTitle: Watercolor Nationality Recognition in the Context of Concrete Painting Based on Texture Recognition and Heterogeneous Database
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper is based on texture recognition and heterogeneous database of concrete painting in the context of watercolor nationality recognition, image-based classification and recognition, and the use of gray-level co-occurrence matrix-based texture feature extraction. Taking the 8-bit grayscale image as the research object, the image is scanned in 4 directions (o, 450, 90, 1350) in sequence, and the aesthetic concept of concrete expression painting is considered. Analyze the experience and works of the concrete expression masters based on the heterogeneous database and establish the friendship cooccurrence matrix respectively to extract the texture feature parameters, and then establish the BP neural network model, and use the extracted texture feature values to train the BP neural network model to make the network model Able to identify the content of the image.

articleTitle: Acceleration Test of Amusement Facilities Based on Sensing Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Based on many years of experience in the large-scale amusement equipment industry and the application of safety regulations, this article has carried out a detailed study and discussion on the realization method of the virtual prototype simulation software ADAMS to measure the human body acceleration and how to carry out the inertial G acceleration conversion after the measurement. The working principle of the wireless acceleration sensor measurement system is introduced. The acceleration analysis and discrimination software is developed based on GB8408-2008, and the acceleration test, analysis and discrimination engineering application of a roller coaster is carried out. The actual measurement results show that the method described in the article is correct and reliable, and can replace physical testing and increase the acceleration of the human body of amusement equipment by 7.3%.

articleTitle: Construction of Yunnan's Agricultural Ecological Civilization Based on Intelligent UAV and SAR Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper studies the construction of Yunnan's agricultural ecological civilization based on the analysis of intelligent drones and SAR images. This article deeply discusses several key problems faced by multi-rotor UAV SAR imaging processing from the aspects of imaging algorithm, motion compensation and auto-focusing, and puts forward an effective imaging processing scheme. The SIFT algorithm is used to extract the image feature points, and the BBF algorithm calculates and generates a matching point set. According to the matching point set, the inter-image perspective transformation model is calculated to complete the image registration, and the wavelet transform algorithm is used to realize the registration image fusion. Based on SAR image analysis and dimensionality reduction of remote sensing data, dimensionality reduction, extraction and classification of remote sensing images of agricultural ecology in Yunnan are carried out.

articleTitle: Research on Data Center Monitoring of Enterprise Standardized Operation in Blockchain E-commerce Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper studies the data testing center of enterprise standardized operation under the blockchain e-commerce environment. China's e-commerce has developed rapidly, and the e-commerce enterprise environment has been established with blockchain technology. From R&D specialization, production standardization, product marketization, Service integration, management informationization, marketing integration, and emergency intelligence have improved the standardized management system of modern enterprises in China under the e-commerce environment. From the big data mining and data detection level and management level, the construction of enterprise data center is discussed. and pointed out the specific strategy to effectively control the implementation risk of the data center.

articleTitle: Self-organizing Feature Data Mining and Analysis Framework of Computer Network Considering Edge Information
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper studies the self-organizing feature data mining and general analysis framework of computer network considering edge information. A significant feature of the Markov decision process is that it has no aftereffect, that is, the state of the system at the next moment only depends on the current state and decision behavior, and has nothing to do with the history of the system. Hence, in the designed model, the new statistical Markov decision chain will be applied. Security loopholes in computer networks are a problem that computer users cannot avoid. In a sense, it is unrealistic to absolutely reject loopholes. In order to better protect the security of computers, it is necessary to then strengthen computer network security management, especially in enterprises. Institutions must also establish a sound management system to prevent information leakage. In the designed scenario, the edge information is also considered to test the robustness.

articleTitle: Computer-based Simulation Data Model for Employment of Business Management Talents in Colleges: Python Implementations
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Computer-based simulation data model for the employment of business management talents in the colleges with Python implementations is studied in this paper. While improving the efficiency of education management, it is necessary to emphasize comprehensive thinking of the entire management process. Its basic idea is to use the created model to explain the changes of dependent variables with the changes of one or more independent variables, and find out the relationship between independent variables and the dependent variables through then testing the model. Besides this, the Python is adopted for the systematic implementations. Python is a pure object-oriented language that supports all object-oriented mechanisms, which makes it applicable to large-scale software project development. Using this tool, the designed model is validated through the further simulation. Compared with the other methods, our design model cam evaluate better.

articleTitle: Face-Assisted Authentication System Based on Mobile Traffic Distribution Platform for English Cloud Classroom Mixed Guidance
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This article relies on the online and offline interactive teaching of the cloud classroom intelligent platform established by Internet technology. By combining online and offline, it gives full play to the role of online teaching resources and information technology, and starts from the cloud classroom intelligent platform activity teaching based on mobile traffic distribution. Use face-assisted verification to analyze the authentication method of this online course, discuss its construction method and application strategy, and then analyze the advantages and application of online and offline hybrid teaching mode in college English teaching, and finally put forward online and offline the optimization of blended teaching mode in college English teaching.

articleTitle: Intelligent Evaluation Model for Landscape Construction of Guangxi Sightseeing Tea Garden Based on Intelligent Scene Object Recognition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The AHP method combined with the Delphi method was used to construct the Guangxi Cangwu County Tourist Tea Garden Landscape Satisfaction Evaluation System based on the six aspects of plant landscape, water landscape, architecture and sketch landscape, supporting facilities, transportation system and cultural experience. Four sightseeing tea gardens in Wuxian County are the research objects, and data are collected by issuing questionnaires. The article takes the landscape design of Guangxi Beibu Bay ecological sightseeing tea garden as an example, and analyzes the design of the natural and cultural landscape of local sightseeing tea gardens in detail, based on intelligent scene object recognition algorithm established an intelligent evaluation model for landscape construction

articleTitle: Enhancing the Coherence of a Meta Search Engine using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: A meta search engine is tool that retrieves information by integrating results from several search engines. The results are put through a ranking process defined by the meta search engine and they are merged into a single consolidated rank list. Result aggregation and ranking process are crucial phases which are important factors for comparison between any two meta search engines. It is a crucial procedure that influences a meta search engine's performance. The earlier developed meta search engine models considered majorly the rank assigned by the underlying search engines and not many other criteria. The naive models were not capable enough to handle the dynamic nature of web. This was the main motive to propose a novel approach that is adaptable to the dynamic nature of the web. The proposed approach uses Best Worst Method (BWM) to assign weights to criteria and Genetic Algorithm with Cluster Dependent Ordered Weighted Average (DOWA) as fitness function to obtain documents list sorted in decreasing order of relevance. This approach has higher precision when compared to the existing models.

articleTitle: Intelligent System of Enterprise Financial Management System Based on Intelligent Voice System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Based on the understanding and analysis of robust optimization and intelligent voice system, this paper establishes a corporate financial management capability system. First of all, this paper uses exploratory factor analysis to find out the structural relationship between multiple observed variables that measure financial management capabilities, and achieve the purpose of data dimensionality reduction. Then through the analysis of the enterprise's financial management ability, the intelligent voice system and the three-dimensional visualization of the model are analyzed, and the results show that the robust optimization and the intelligent voice system increase the enterprise's financial management ability by 9.1%. Finally, experiments and simulations verify that the robust optimization and intelligent voice system can be used to establish a corporate financial management capability system.

articleTitle: 3-Phase Power Quality Improvement using ZETA Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Power Quality improvement based on the voltage, frequency and harmonics power delivery to the systems. This approach implemented among the Proportional integral (PI) and Artificial intelligence (AI) for improving the quality of power. In many electronic devices, the quality of power improved by connecting the grid to the non-linear loads. It provides reduced quality frequency and harmonics. This process, when employed based on Hysteresis Current Controller, will provide high power quality. The frequency that is switching and changing for each load determined with hysteresis current controller for each load. The performance will be higher with three phases DC/AC embedded DC/AC converter. It converts the voltage and projects active filtering process to execute converter with high performance. In this paper, a comparative analysis made between AI and PI to improve power quality.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Semantic Recognition and Self-Organizing Feature Mapping of Chinese Linguistics Under Big Data Informationization
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In order to study the intelligent semantic recognition of Chinese linguistics under the informationization of big data, this paper designs a set of quantified pressure index system, and introduces a self-organizing feature map (SOM) neural network model with strong clustering and fault tolerance. Explain that on the basis of the SOM network model and algorithm, apply the clustering function of SOM to construct the SOM network model in MATLAB language, showing the visualization characteristics of the self-organizing feature map of Chinese linguistics for clustering, including the visualization and clustering process. Visualization of clustering results.

articleTitle: Automated Epileptic Seizure Detection using Principal Component Analysis Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Epilepsy is a serious chronic neurological disorder and the most common brain disease after a migraine. It has various symptoms, as loss of awareness, irregular behavior, and seizure. Electroencephalogram (EEG) waveform is a prime source commonly used for the diagnosis of epilepsy. However, the EEG-based diagnosis faces many issues in real-time situations due to the coupling of various noises and the non-stationary nature of the signals which affects the accuracy of detection of an epileptic seizure. Therefore, a machine learning approach is proposed for the automatic detection of epileptic seizures by training the model to differentiate the seizure and normal person based on EEG signal artifacts. In this work, the Principal Component Analysis (PCA) has been used to reduce the dimensionality of the EEG dataset. The results on the dataset show superior performance of the proposed approach. This approach is robust in nature and achieved the best classification accuracy of 100%. Finally, the presented method supports the high detection performance, less complexity, and the possibility to develop an automated epileptic seizure detection hardware system.

articleTitle: Application of VR Virtual Reality Technology and OLAP in the JAVA Certification System for College Design Teaching
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Data and information release based on VR and OLAP has gradually shifted from text release to multiple forms of graphics, imagery and its hybrid development. It discusses a new real-time information release mode for OLAP system under the JAVA certification system in college design and teaching, and proposes In the distributed environment of XML-WebService, a comprehensive implementation plan combining several technologies of. NET+XML-SVG+JavaScript is adopted to realize the real-time publishing mode of OLAP information in the form of websites, and provide dynamic interactive performance, which improves OLAP system is a solution in this field.
